permission-owner.name: uPortal System
permission-owner.desc: Permissions controlling the base uPortal system

activity.name: Add Tab
activity.desc: Allow the user to add a layout tab

activity.name: Customize
activity.desc: Allows access to the Customize menu in the UI

activity.name: Delete Entity
activity.desc: Allow the user to delete a portal entity within the ImportExportPortlet

activity.name: Export Entity
activity.desc: Allow the user to export entity XML from the ImportExportPortlet

activity.name: Favorite
activity.desc: Allow the user to add a portlet to his or her favorites

activity.name: Import Entity
activity.desc: Allow the user to import entity XML using the ImportExportPortlet

activity.name: Superuser
activity.desc: Receive *any* portal permission. This permission covers all \n permissions for all systems, is not blockable, and is only intended\n to be granted to superusers.
